data_description.vehicle_name: The name shown for this camper.
data_description.tracker_entity: The device_tracker entity that provides current coordinates.
data_description.recording_enabled: Store valid GPS points locally when enabled.
data_description.min_movement: Minimum distance required for a new GPS point.
data_description.retention_days: How long unassigned GPS data is retained.
data_description.stop_after: Time without movement before a drive ends.
data_description.max_gap: Longest GPS gap still considered part of a drive.
data_description.map_provider: Choose CARTO Basemaps or no background map.
data_description.carto_api_key: The key is sent to the browser for tile requests and is visible in browser network tools.
data_description.remove_carto_api_key: Clear the stored key; this also disables CARTO until a new key is entered.
data_description.home_radius_m: Coordinates within this radius are shown as Home; no stay is created.
data_description.reverse_geocoding_enabled: Disabled by default. When enabled, only relevant drive endpoints are sent to Nominatim and results are cached.
